expectations.evidence: Research report identifies 4+ source types: art books (Tier 1), digital/exhibition/web sources (Tier 2), game-adjacent digital releases (Tier 3), and video sources (Tier 4). sources.json includes art_book, web_archive, web_gallery, press_kit, digital_release, illustrated_book, and video types.

Sources use 'Tier 1/2/3/4' labels and numeric 'priority' fields (1-4) in sources.json, but do NOT use the required A/B/C tier labels. No mention of A, B, or C tier classification anywhere in the outputs.

sources.json contains 13 source entries each with url (or description), type, and description/notes fields. Example: src-007 has url 'https://finalfantasy.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Yoshitaka_Amano_artwork', type 'web_archive', and notes describing content.
Dataset plan uses gallery-dl commands and generic wget-style approaches. No reference to the specific 'download_images.py' script with --urls-file, --output-dir, --min-resolution flags.
Dataset plan provides detailed accept/reject criteria in Phase 2 with checkboxes and directory structure (accept/reject/maybe). However, there is no mention of 'keep.txt' anywhere in the outputs.
Dataset plan uses ImageMagick 'convert' commands for resizing and processing. No reference to the specific 'prepare_dataset.py' script with --target-resolution 1024 and --crop-mode smart flags.
Dataset plan uses 'caption_with_blip2.py' and 'tag_images_by_wd14_tagger.py' for captioning. No reference to the specific 'auto_caption.py' script with --trigger-word, --mode, --captioner flags.

Multiple sample captions contain style-describing words. Caption 1: 'watercolor and ink illustration'. Caption 4: 'ethereal watercolor landscape'. Caption 5: 'dark fantasy watercolor and ink illustration'. Caption 6: 'abstract watercolor composition...decorative illustration'. The word 'illustration' appears in nearly every caption.

Captions use format '{trigger}, watercolor and ink illustration of...' or '{trigger}, ink and watercolor portrait of...'. They do NOT use the required '{trigger} style, {description}' format. The word 'style' does not follow the trigger token.

Dataset plan includes a validation script (Phase 5C) that produces a report with total image count, min dimensions (resolution stats), and caption coverage (with_caption count). The research report also includes estimated dataset sizes (80-100 min, 150-250 target).

Dataset plan Phase 6 provides detailed training configuration for both kohya_ss (SDXL) and ai-toolkit (FLUX), including specific training parameters (learning rate, network dim, batch size, etc.). The pipeline checklist ends with 'Post-training: Test with prompts, iterate on dataset/captions if results are off.'

Dataset plan Phase 2D includes a 'Dataset Balance Check' table with target percentages for 6 categories (single character portraits 30-40%, full-body 20-30%, etc.) and states: 'If any category is severely underrepresented, go back to acquisition and target that gap.' Research report also notes video extraction as low priority and identifies potential resolution gaps.
